edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved every/all, joy, fellowship, chains, fruit, flesh/body, life/death, common-life and united-striving language. Smoothed remembrance, petitions, progress and the choice/struggle clauses; modernized has. Retained love at 1:16 and ambition at 1:17 in the NA28 order, the shorter word at 1:14, and the bracketed for at 1:23 and in at 1:24.

chapters.decision: Preserved repeated if, same/one thinking, form/appearance distinctions, equality with God, emptying Himself without an added object, slave, death/cross, every knee/tongue, and working in 2:12–13. Updated ordinary you/my and smoothed their sentence. Like mind at 2:20 expresses the inherited like soul idiom; soul language remains explicit in its note. Retained the bracketed also at 2:4 and all poured-out, sacrifice, running, soldier and sorrow images.

chapters.decision: Preserved the three watch out commands, mutilation/circumcision contrast, lineage and eighth day, gain/loss/refuse, flesh, resurrection, repeated taking hold, race/goal/prize, belly and citizenship/body images. Smoothed several sentence structures. Jesus at 3:12 is added from bracketed NA28 wording; the shorter earlier form is archived. But at 3:7 and the bracketed articles at 3:10 are reflected in the retained English. The shorter 3:16 remains.

chapters.decision: Preserved the repeated appeals to Euodia and Syntyche, yoke-fellow, repeated rejoice, every whatever clause, joy/crown, future will guard, contentment in plenty and need, once and twice, fruit/account, fragrance/sacrifice and fill language. Recovered the blossoming image at 4:10. Modernized surpasses/will and smoothed practice and circumstances. Retained the shorter 4:13 without adding Christ, and no final Amen at 4:23.
